info.title: Nylorun Management API
info.description: For operators: the Tenant's models, vaults, signing keys, settings and application keys, at `/v1/tenant/*` on the Tenant's URL, through `@nylorun/admin`. Every operation takes a management key, acting as itself: never for a subject and never from a browser. Management keys are issued only on the Tenant's machine (`nylorun tenant keys put <id> --management`) or from `NYLORUN_MANAGEMENT_KEY_FILE`.

servers.description: A Runtime: a local Tenant (`nylorun start`), or where yours runs

applicationKey.description: An application key of the Tenant (`PUT /v1/tenant/keys/{keyId}`), or Studio's key, derived from the admin key. With `Nylorun-Subject` and `Nylorun-Scopes`, it acts for that person, narrowed to those scopes. Never accepted from a browser (`Origin`).

managementKey.description: A management key of the Tenant (role `management`): it reaches the Management API (`/v1/tenant/*`) and `/v1/me`, as itself, never for a subject. Issued only on the Tenant's machine (`nylorun-operate keys put <id> --role management`) or from `NYLORUN_MANAGEMENT_KEY_FILE`. Never accepted from a browser (`Origin`).

issuerToken.description: A JWT from a trusted issuer of the Host's identity file (Host feature `trusted-issuers`): one person, with the issuer's scopes, agents and sandbox grants, until it expires. Accepted from servers and browsers alike; CORS is the operator's proxy's.

put.description: Replaces every rule. The Tool Gate applies them to each MCP and HTTP tool call of every harness, before it sends the call: the strictest rule that matches decides. `deny` refuses the call (the model gets `tool.denied`), `ask` holds it and pauses the turn until a person answers it with an `approve` command on the session, `allow` runs it. A call no rule matches runs. A rule matches when every selector it sets matches: `tool` (the name the model calls it by; `*` matches any run of characters), `server` (an MCP server's name), `kind` (`mcp` or `http`), `agent` (the agent that calls it) and `when` (fields of the call's input by dotted path, each tested with `equals`, `in`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte` or `matches`). Sandbox tools never cross the gate. An empty list allows every call.

post.description: Connects to the remote MCP server at `url` with the credential for that URL in the vault of the Agent `agentId`, if given (its headers and `via`; never an identity header), under the Host's address policy, lists its tools within 15 s and closes the connection. It never calls a tool. Each tool comes with the name the model would call it (`modelName`, made with `name`), its annotations and its input schema's size. A server that answers `401` is `authRequired`, with its RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata when it publishes any: it needs a person's sign-in, so reach it through a gateway (`via`), or with a key. No credential value is in the answer.

get.description: The sizes, counts and deadlines the Runtime holds what crosses it to: the Tenant's (Tenant setting `limits.config`), with the default for each it leaves out. Harnesses get the ones they must respect in `turn.start.limits` (record entry, model call, model file, tool answer, custom harness state, Harness API chunk, folder entries). Defaults and ceilings: `recordEntryBytes` 983040 bytes, at most 983040 (S2 takes records of at most 1048576 bytes, and an event's envelope needs 65536 beside its payload); `modelCallBytes` 33554432 bytes, at most 536870888 (the Model Gate reads a call's body as one string, of at most 536870888 characters); `modelFileBytes` 8388608 bytes, at most 402653166 (a file goes to the provider as one base64 string, of at most 536870888 characters); `toolAnswerBytes` 8388608 bytes, at most 33554432 (a harness reports the answer to core in one Harness API frame (67108864 bytes), as JSON, whose escapes may double it); `harnessStateBytes` 262144 bytes, at most 33554432 (the state crosses in one Harness API frame (67108864 bytes) with the rest of its output or turn.start); `chunkBytes` 16777216 bytes, at most 50266112 (a chunk crosses in base64 in one Harness API frame (67108864 bytes), with room for the frame's own JSON); `folderEntries` 10000 entries, at most 4628197 (a folder's manifest is read as one string, of at most 536870888 characters, and each entry takes at least 116); `requestBodyBytes` 1048576 bytes, at most 536870888 (a body is read as one string, of at most 536870888 characters); `messageParts` 32 entries, at most 19884106 (parts arrive in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 27); `pageItems` 200 entries, at most 178956962 (a page's items go in one response body, written as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 3); `exportPageItems` 1000 entries, at most 178956962 (a page's calls go in one response body, written as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 3); `environmentEventItems` 1000 entries, at most 178956962 (the events go in one response body, written as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 3); `inlineFileBytes` 20971520 bytes, at most 402653166 (a file sent inline arrives in base64 in a body read as one string, of at most 536870888 characters); `a2aWaitMs` 300000 milliseconds, at most 2147483647 (the wait is timed with a JavaScript timer, which waits at most 2147483647 ms); `errorExcerptChars` 2000 characters, at most 163840 (the excerpt is kept in one record entry (at most 983040 bytes), where JSON may escape a character to 6); `traceContentBytes` 8192 bytes, at most 983040 (span content is cut from one record entry, which holds at most 983040 bytes); `environmentLabels` 32 entries, at most 59652320 (labels arrive in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 9); `artifactLabels` 32 entries, at most 59652320 (labels arrive in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 9); `labelKeyChars` 63 characters, at most 536870888 (a label key arrives in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters); `labelValueChars` 256 characters, at most 536870888 (a label value arrives in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters); `environmentSetupCommands` 16 entries, at most 33554430 (setup commands arrive in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 16); `environmentFiles` 16 entries, at most 16268814 (input file entries arrive in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 33); `environmentFilesPerEntry` 1000 entries, at most 6710886 (the files of an entry arrive in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 80); `environmentSecretSlots` 64 entries, at most 14128181 (secret slots arrive in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 38); `setupCommandChars` 4096 characters, at most 43690 (a command runs as one argument of /bin/sh -c, which Linux takes up to 131072 bytes long (MAX_ARG_STRLEN, with its NUL), and UTF-8 may take 3 bytes for a character); `setupCommandMs` 1800000 milliseconds, at most 2147483647 (the engine times a command with a JavaScript timer, which waits at most 2147483647 ms); `setupOutputChars` 4096 characters, at most 163840 (the output is kept in one record entry (at most 983040 bytes), where JSON may escape a character to 6); `setupReasonChars` 500 characters, at most 163840 (the reason is kept in one record entry (at most 983040 bytes), where JSON may escape a character to 6); `setupCommandExcerptChars` 80 characters, at most 163840 (the reason is kept in one record entry (at most 983040 bytes), where JSON may escape a character to 6); `manifestDescriptionChars` 1024 characters, at most 536870888 (a description arrives in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters); `secretDescriptionChars` 500 characters, at most 536870888 (a description arrives in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters); `secretValueChars` 8192 characters, at most 536870888 (a value arrives in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters); `secretHosts` 32 entries, at most 89478481 (hosts arrive in one request body, read as one string of at most 536870888 characters, and each takes at least 6); `diskVersionEntries` 200000 entries, at most 1917396 (a disk is listed in one Harness API frame (67108864 bytes, each entry at least 35), and a version's manifest is read as one string of at most 536870888 characters); `diskVersionBytes` 10737418240 bytes, at most 9007199254740991 (the files' sizes are added up in a JavaScript number, exact up to 9007199254740991); `diskLeaseMs` 120000 milliseconds, at most 2147483647 (the lease is renewed with a JavaScript timer, which waits at most 2147483647 ms); `diskPodWaitMs` 60000 milliseconds, at most 9007199254740991 (the deadline is reckoned from the clock in a JavaScript number, exact up to 9007199254740991); `modelRequestMs` 600000 milliseconds, at most 2147483647 (the provider's SDK times the request with a JavaScript timer, which waits at most 2147483647 ms); `modelIdleMs` 300000 milliseconds, at most 2147483647 (the stream's silence is timed with a JavaScript timer, which waits at most 2147483647 ms); `modelAttempts` 3 attempts, at most 9007199254740991 (attempts are counted in a JavaScript number, exact up to 9007199254740991); `modelRetryDelayMs` 2000 milliseconds, at most 2147483647 (the delay is waited with a JavaScript timer, which waits at most 2147483647 ms); `modelProviderRetries` 2 retries, at most 9007199254740991 (retries are counted in a JavaScript number, exact up to 9007199254740991); `modelRetryDelayMaxMs` 60000 milliseconds, at most 2147483647 (the delay is waited with a JavaScript timer, which waits at most 2147483647 ms); `toolAttempts` 3 attempts, at most 9007199254740991 (sends are counted in a JavaScript number, exact up to 9007199254740991); `httpToolTimeoutMs` 300000 milliseconds, at most 2147483647 (the call is timed with a JavaScript timer, which waits at most 2147483647 ms); `mcpSnapshotBytes` 4194304 bytes, at most 16777216 (the facts cross in turn.start, one Harness API frame (67108864 bytes), beside the harness's state (at most half of it) and the rest); `mcpPreviewMs` 15000 milliseconds, at most 2147483647 (the preview is timed with a JavaScript timer, which waits at most 2147483647 ms); `mcpMetadataBytes` 65536 bytes, at most 536870888 (the document is read as one string, of at most 536870888 characters); tags.name: Tenant
tags.description: The Tenant's status, and seeding or resetting it. `admin.tenant` in `@nylorun/admin`.

tags.name: Application keys
tags.description: The keys app servers call the Runtime API with: create, rotate, list and delete them. Management keys come only from the Tenant's machine. `admin.keys`.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: Model providers, their credentials, the model the Tenant uses, what each model reads, what it spent, every model call for export, and the budgets that cap it. `admin.models`.

tags.name: Tool policy
tags.description: The rules the Tool Gate applies to every MCP and HTTP tool call of every harness: refuse it, hold it for a person's approval, or run it. `admin.toolPolicy`.

tags.name: Credential coverage
tags.description: Which secret of an Agent's vault each of its manifest's MCP servers and HTTP tools would get, before a session opens. The secrets themselves are written on the Runtime API. `admin.coverage`.

tags.name: MCP servers
tags.description: See a remote MCP server's tools before an agent names it, with an Agent's credential for its URL: their model names, sizes and annotations, or that it needs a person's sign-in. `admin.mcp`.

tags.name: Signing keys
tags.description: The keys the Runtime signs capability links and run tokens with; their public halves are the Runtime API's JWKS. `admin.signingKeys`.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: The Tenant's sandbox backend, Agent compute, artifact and skill settings, and its Runtime limits. `admin.settings`.
